episodes.title: Dash
episodes.summary: Dash hates Christmas, but his Yuletide spirits brighten when he finds a mysterious red notebook filled with clues hidden at his favorite bookstore.

episodes.title: Lily
episodes.summary: Lily loves Christmas, but the prospect of a lonely holiday inspires her to connect with Dash through the notebook - and send him on another dare.

episodes.title: Hannukah
episodes.summary: After Lily shares the memory of her worst Christmas ever, Dash devises a late-night challenge that pushes her far outside her comfort zone.

episodes.title: Cinderella
episodes.summary: When Dash discovers Lily didn't leave the notebook in their prearranged spot, he tries to track her down using the unique footwear she left behind.

episodes.title: Sofia & Edgar
episodes.summary: As Dash and Lily forge a deeper connection with dares involving mochi and a Muppet, they deal with past heartbreaks and family issues.

episodes.title: Christmas Eve
episodes.summary: Real-life distractions complicate Dash and Lily's letter-based relationship when they both decide to attend a holiday party with other people.

episodes.title: Christmas
episodes.summary: Lily's problems pile up after a dreary Christmas morning and an enlightening pun lead her to question everything she knows about Dash.

episodes.title: New Year's Eve
episodes.summary: With the year's final hours ticking down, Dash does some soul-searching and comes to a decision about Lily, unaware that her life is about to change.
